name: 32927 · Cocoa, FL
findings: ZIP 32927 (Cocoa) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32927 (Cocoa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
